title: Death of Bilgames: Ziusudra the last to be given immortality

tellings.quote: there's an obscure tablet called the death of billig games and it is a tablet and bames is another name for Gilgamesh and you find out in that that these anuna Gods had given the Noah figure Zas sudra the he was the last man ever to get immortality

plain: An ancient Mesopotamian clay tablet called The Death of Bilgames (Bilgames is another name for Gilgamesh, the legendary king) is said to tell how the gods called the Anunnaki gave immortality to Ziusudra, the Noah figure of the flood story, and that he was the last man ever to receive it. The researcher of ancient history Matt LaCroix brings it up as an "obscure tablet", without naming any other source. He tells it because, if true, it would mean the old gods once granted eternal life to humans and then stopped.
